input: Plan a solo birthday weekend in the mountains

gold.taskTitle: Plan a Solo Birthday Mountain Weekend
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to plan a solo weekend trip to the mountains to celebrate their birthday.

questions.title: Which specific mountain region or destination do you have in mind?
questions.description: Identify the target location or mountain range for the trip.

questions.title: What dates is your birthday weekend falling on?
questions.description: Determine the exact travel dates to plan around.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the entire weekend?
questions.description: Understand financial constraints to guide accommodation and activity choices.

questions.title: What type of accommodation do you prefer to stay in?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a cabin, hotel, hostel, campsite, or other lodging.

questions.title: What activities are you hoping to do in the mountains?
questions.description: Identify preferred activities such as hiking, skiing, relaxing, or sightseeing.

questions.title: How will you be getting to the mountain destination?
questions.description: Determine the mode of transport — driving, flying, or other — to plan logistics.

questions.title: Is this trip purely relaxing or do you want structured daily plans?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants a loose itinerary or detailed hour-by-hour scheduling.
